title: SplatPack: shared field survives as a practical representation
summary: SplatPack turns the useful residue of SplatWorld4 into an engineering object. After the stronger operator-specific story lost to capacity-matched controls, the shared smooth position/scene field survives together with sparse local residual exceptions and a practical rasterisation path.

nodes.claim: Packages a multi-scene splat representation in which a shared smooth position/scene field plus sparse local residual corrections predicts RGB and opacity for rendering.
nodes.survived: The compact shared-field plus sparse-exception idea survives as an engineering representation even after the stronger operator-specific hypothesis lost to capacity-matched controls.
nodes.killed: The package is not evidence for a Fourier, Gabor or wavebank operator mechanism and does not claim state-of-the-art 3-D reconstruction quality.

edges.why: SplatPack explicitly follows SplatWorld4 after the stronger operator mechanism lost capacity-matched controls, retaining the useful shared smooth field while adding sparse local residual exceptions and a practical renderer.
